method.decisionSeedFormula: Same deterministic mix32 formula used by existing audit-observable.cjs; policy/trial/turn only. Actual RNG, routes and future refills never enter a player decision.
method.certificateScope: Every current published campaign variant route plus original legacy route; deterministic exact replay, score and ground goals, current move budget.
method.proofScope: Classic-v4 swaps only from the current state and remaining move budget. No booster, extra-move rescue or metagame economy is part of impossibility claims.
method.searchClassification: The existing solverProbes.classification field is a compatibility summary: a replay-verified route is proven_winnable; no route remains unknown_within_search_budget as in the historical report. The additive solverProbes.search object is the current solveWithReport result: classification, independent limitation flags, exact termination reason, prefix replay and actual child budget. An unpruned exhaustive search may prove only the current unaided state unwinnable; a beam-pruned or budget-limited search stays unknown.
method.hintSelection: At most one first off-certificate playing state at turn>=2 per variant/policy; node budget ignores wall-clock. Hint is measured, never used to choose policy moves.
method.hintWorkAccounting: Hint searchedNodes counts search child expansions; authored continuation replay on a clone is separate verification work. These probes are off-certificate states, so no matching authored continuation is verified. Hint decisions and their existing fields retain the same semantics.
method.performance: Offline development tool only, no runtime/browser worker integration. Work is fixed at1280 episodes, at most160 strict-node hint probes and40 existing bounded solver calls. solveWithReport checks maxNodes before every child, including terminal wins and losses. Independently instrumented swap counts exclude prefix replay, must equal searchedNodes and cannot exceed the requested bound. historicalSoftBudgetReference preserves the old A-01 overrun as historical evidence. No runtime solver is added.
